title: Testing robotics code: examples, properties, mutants and launch tests
summary: Run your stack's own suite, break it on purpose and restore it with git; write example tests and hypothesis properties strong enough to kill mutants you have never seen; play saboteur against the stack's own tests; then write a launch test that starts NAVERA Lite's judge and proves that a 5 km jump is refused and a NaN fix gives NO_FIX.
